name: error-parent-harness-id-empty
description: A malformed producer sends an empty x-tapes-parent-harness-id beside a parent session id. The reader omits it, so the parent resolves in the child's harness.

error.rule: an empty parent-harness header is omitted by the reader, not normalised to unknown; the reject-empty rule guards the JSON body path, not headers

grounding: The reader only sets parent_harness_id when the header is non-empty, so an empty one drops out and the parent falls back to the child's harness namespace.
notes: Unlike x-tapes-harness-id, an empty parent harness is not substituted with "unknown": an unknown parent harness names no session anyone can resolve.
